result.subject: My kettle came a week late
result.body: Hi, my order ORD-5531 (the Kestrel kettle) was promised for 3 March but only arrived on 10 March. The kettle is fine, but the delivery was a week late and I paid for express shipping. Can I get my shipping fee back? Thanks, Dana.

args.message:
Hi Dana,

Thanks for reaching out. I’m sorry for the delay in delivery. As per our late‑delivery refund policy, we’ve issued a refund of $8.50 to the original payment method (Visa ending 4242). You should see the credit on your statement within 3‑5 business days.

If you have any other questions, let us know!

Best,
Brightloop Support

args.resolution_note: Refunded $8.50 shipping fee for late delivery. Customer notified.
